children: ESDS Software Solution shares hit the lower circuit limit of 5 percent in Wednesday's trading session amid profit booking, after rising sharply from their listing price.
The shares quoted at Rs 1,733.50 per share on the NSE, down 5 percent from the previous close and at the lowest permissible trading limit for the session.

ESDS Software Solution shares were listed at Rs 757 per share on the NSE, a premium of 76.46 percent over the issue price, earlier this month. The Rs 720-crore initial public offering had a price band of Rs 408-429 per share.
At Rs 1,733.50, the stock has gained 129.07 percent from its listing price of Rs 757.
The stock had witnessed back-to-back upper circuits in the previous several sessions.
Its circuit limit was earlier changed from 20 percent to 10 percent and has now been reduced to 5 percent.
ESDS Software Solution is an AI-enabled cloud, managed services, data centre infrastructure and software solutions provider.
